note: The 7 organic 'stone'/blob shapes. Defined ONCE and referenced by id. No route adds new path data — routes only recombine these 7 with different fills, images and rotations.
mechanism: plain <div> clipped by an inline <clipPath clipPathUnits="objectBoundingBox"> served from a 0x0 hidden fixed container; applied as clip-path: url(#id)
renderedAs: one JSX <clipPath> element mapped over a 7-entry SHAPES array (so the source contains 1 literal <clipPath>, the DOM contains 7)

transforms.rotate-90: transform: rotate(90deg) -> matrix(0,1,-1,0,0,0); used on /parents hero bottom shape and /careers hero bottom shape

aiGuidance: A generated instance MAY pick any of these 7 ids and any foundation colour fill. It MUST NOT invent new path data — the shape vocabulary is closed.
